skill.name: grill-with-docs
skill.description: Conducts a focused interview to sharpen a plan or design while creating architecture decision records and a shared glossary.
skill.summary: Challenge assumptions, refine designs, and document decisions through a structured interview.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The sole static finding is a false positive because SKILL.md line 7 uses Markdown backticks around slash-command names, not executable shell syntax. The eight-line prompt delegates to two skills and contains no prompt injection or malicious intent.

static_findings.snippet: Run a `/grilling` session, using the `/domain-modeling` skill.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 7 uses Markdown backticks to format the slash-command names `/grilling` and `/domain-modeling`; it contains no Ruby or shell execution syntax.

content.user_title: Sharpen Plans and Create Decision Documentation
content.value_statement: Unresolved assumptions weaken plans and technical designs. This skill conducts a focused interview and uses domain modeling to produce ADRs and a glossary.
actual_capabilities: Starts a grilling session for a plan or design.
Uses the domain-modeling skill during the interview.
Challenges assumptions through persistent follow-up questions.
Refines unclear design choices and planning decisions.
Creates architecture decision records and a glossary during the session.
limitations: Requires the separate grilling and domain-modeling skills to be available.
Does not implement the resulting plan or design.
Produces documentation from supplied context, so missing details reduce accuracy.
Does not replace expert review for security, legal, or compliance decisions.

use_cases.title: Review a technical proposal
use_cases.description: Expose assumptions and unresolved choices before an engineering team commits to implementation.

use_cases.title: Refine a feature plan
use_cases.description: Clarify users, workflows, constraints, and terminology before a feature enters delivery.

use_cases.title: Document architecture decisions
use_cases.description: Compare alternatives, record tradeoffs, and establish shared domain language for a system design.

prompt_templates.title: Review a basic plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use grill-with-docs to interview me about this plan: [plan]. Identify assumptions and create ADRs and a glossary as decisions emerge.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an early plan

prompt_templates.title: Challenge a feature design
prompt_templates.prompt: Run grill-with-docs on this feature design: [design]. Focus on users, boundaries, failure cases, dependencies, and unresolved decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve architecture alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Use grill-with-docs to compare [option A] and [option B] for [system]. Question constraints, document tradeoffs, and record the selected decision.

prompt_templates.title: Stress-test a domain model
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an advanced grill-with-docs session for [domain]. Challenge entities, invariants, workflows, ownership boundaries, failure modes, and terminology. Produce ADRs and a glossary.

output_examples.input: A team must choose synchronous or event-driven order notifications.
output: Decision: Use asynchronous events for order notifications while keeping payment confirmation synchronous.
ADR: This balances response time with reliable payment feedback.
Glossary: Order event means a durable record of an order state change.

output_examples.input: Plan organization-level access controls for an existing application.
output: Key assumption: Organization membership is managed by administrators.
ADR: Apply role checks at the service boundary.
Glossary: Organization role means a named permission set within one organization.
Open question: How should access change during pending invitations?

best_practices: Provide the current plan, constraints, stakeholders, and known uncertainties before starting.
Answer follow-up questions with concrete evidence and state when information is unknown.
Review each ADR and glossary term before treating the documentation as final.
anti_patterns: Do not use the session when you only need a quick factual answer.
Do not hide fixed constraints or decisions that are no longer open.
Do not accept generated ADRs without checking ownership, consequences, and unresolved risks.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews plans and designs through a structured interview focused on assumptions, decisions, and domain concepts.

faq.question: What documentation does it create?
faq.answer: It creates architecture decision records and a glossary while the plan or design is examined.

faq.question: Does it require other skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It invokes the grilling session and uses the domain-modeling skill.

faq.question: Can it implement the final plan?
faq.answer: No. It sharpens and documents the plan but does not perform implementation work.

faq.question: What should I provide before starting?
faq.answer: Provide the plan, known constraints, stakeholders, open questions, and any decisions already made.

faq.question: Should I accept every generated decision?
faq.answer: No. Review each decision, consequence, and glossary term with the responsible stakeholders.
